hook_text: SHE POURED MILK ON HER ONLY FISH

scenes.visual: a busy market street; {Duchess} on a velvet cushion tipping a jug of milk over a small fish on the ground; {Mochi} below her, frozen, staring at the ruined fish
scenes.action: milk pours over the fish, Mochi's ears drop and her eyes fill with tears, Duchess smirks

lines.speaker: Duchess
lines.text: Know your *place*, street cat. This street is *mine*.

scenes.visual: {Rocco} standing behind Duchess, laughing loudly with his head thrown back, market cats watching in the background
scenes.action: Rocco throws his head back and laughs, his gold chain swinging

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mochi had saved that fish for three days. It was all she had.

scenes.visual: {Bruno} stepping in front of {Mochi} protectively on the market street, chest out, facing the camera
scenes.action: Bruno steps forward in front of Mochi and puffs out his chest, trembling but brave

scenes.visual: close-up of {Mochi} wiping her eye with a paw, chin lifting, a quiet fierce look
scenes.action: Mochi slowly lifts her chin, her eyes go from teary to determined

lines.speaker: Mochi
lines.text: It's fine, Bruno. One day, they'll *remember* this.

scenes.visual: {Granny} in the doorway of a tiny old bakery at the end of the street, watching, holding a warm loaf
scenes.action: Granny lowers her glasses and smiles slowly, as if she has a plan

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But someone at the end of the street had seen everything.
